definitions:
taco-r2 items M2b and M2c: fair untuned baselines and one definition of "default" and "best static" per kernel.
CPU only; reads stored result files and times nothing.

M2b  Untuned and cheap baselines on every per-call data set of the Triton Mamba-1 scan of this study (device time,
     three GPUs; launch-inclusive; the 1.4B and 2.8B widths; CUDA-graph replay on two GPUs), of the reference CUDA
     scan (launch-inclusive and device time) and of the production kernels (Mamba-2 SSD 370M / 2.7B and Gated
     DeltaNet 1.4B under CUDA-graph replay on two GPUs, launch-inclusive and device time on the RTX 3090):
       free length rule   C = clip(nextpow2(L), C_min, C_max) over the kernel's chunk set, which mirrors the
                          reference scan's stock dispatch (clip(nextpow2(L), 128, 2048)); no timing at all
       capped default     max(C_min, min(C_default, nextpow2(L))) for kernels with a library default
       static chunks      one chunk for all calls / one per batch size, chosen by mean per-call regret or by total
                          latency, in sample or on the training prompt folds (held out)
       length-bucket table  keyed on (power-of-two length bucket, batch) [and the alignment bit], held out
       exact-shape table  the manuscript's held-out exact-shape table (profiled reference)
       cost model         the frozen eight-parameter fit and the a-priori forms of the M4a protocols (device time;
                          per-call choices from ``taco_r2_baselines_m4.json``)
     Each with per-call mean / p95 / max, within-2% share, latency-weighted share of the oracle scan time (LW),
     microseconds per call, ms per forward pass, per batch, and 95% prompt-cluster intervals; paired differences
     against the free length rule (per call and LW). Also why the calibration-only length tree loses to the rule.
M2c  An inventory of the definitions of "default" and "best static" used by the manuscript's tables and one
     proposed definition per kernel, with the affected numbers recomputed under it.

Outputs: ``taco_r2_baselines_m2b.json`` and ``taco_r2_baselines_m2c.json``.

Usage:  PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m src.experiments.tpds.taco_r2_untuned_baselines [--n-boot 2000]

policy_definitions.default_chunk_256: fixed chunk 256 (the Mamba-2 SSD default, borrowed; the manuscript's untuned reference of the Triton scan)
policy_definitions.library_default: the library default chunk of the kernel (SSD 256, Gated DeltaNet 64)
policy_definitions.free_length_rule: C = clip(nextpow2(L), C_min, C_max) over the kernel's chunk set (no timing; mirrors the stock dispatch of the reference CUDA scan, clip(nextpow2(L), 128, 2048))
policy_definitions.capped_default: C = max(C_min, min(C_default, nextpow2(L))): the library default capped at the next power of two of the length (no timing)
policy_definitions.stock_length_rule: the reference scan's stock dispatch chunk, timed in the runtime-chunk build
policy_definitions.best_static_global_insample_regret: one chunk for all calls, lowest mean per-call regret on the scored calls
policy_definitions.best_static_global_insample_latency: one chunk for all calls, lowest total latency on the scored calls
policy_definitions.best_static_global_heldout_regret: one chunk, lowest mean per-call regret on the training prompt folds
policy_definitions.best_static_global_heldout_latency: one chunk, lowest total latency on the training prompt folds
policy_definitions.best_static_per_batch_insample_regret: one chunk per batch size, lowest mean per-call regret (in sample)
policy_definitions.best_static_per_batch_insample_latency: one chunk per batch size, lowest total latency (in sample)
policy_definitions.best_static_per_batch_heldout_regret: one chunk per batch size, lowest mean per-call regret on the training folds (fallback: the global chunk of the training folds)
policy_definitions.best_static_per_batch_heldout_latency: one chunk per batch size, lowest total latency on the training folds
policy_definitions.length_bucket_table_heldout_latency: table keyed on (power-of-two length bucket, batch), entry = lowest mean latency on the training folds, fallback the chunk with the lowest mean latency (the estimator of the supplementary bucket-headroom table)
policy_definitions.length_bucket_aligned_table_heldout_late: as above, keyed on (length bucket, batch, L mod 16 = 0)
policy_definitions.length_bucket_table_heldout_regret: table keyed on (length bucket, batch), entry = lowest mean per-call regret on the training folds
policy_definitions.exact_shape_table_heldout_regret: exact-shape table (L, batch, width, alignment) with a (bucket, batch, alignment) and a global fallback, entries by mean per-call regret on the training folds (the manuscript's held-out exact-shape table)
policy_definitions.cost_model_frozen: Eq. (3) with the stored eight-parameter fit of the GPU (form frozen on two GPUs' calls)

conventions.lw_share_of_oracle_pct: 100 x sum(excess latency) / sum(oracle latency) (Tables 4 and 7)
